name: NVIDIA SkillSpector
description: Scan agent skills, plugins, and MCP servers before installing them — detects prompt injection, data exfiltration, malicious patterns, and supply-chain risk in Claude Code and Codex skills.

skills.name: Skill Scanning
skills.description: Analyzes an agent skill or plugin package for malicious instructions and risky capabilities before installation.

skills.name: Injection Detection
skills.description: Flags prompt-injection and instruction-override patterns embedded in skill files, docs, and tool descriptions.

skills.name: Exfiltration Checks
skills.description: Identifies network calls and file access paths that could move credentials or source code off the machine.

skills.name: Supply Chain Audit
skills.description: Inspects declared dependencies and install hooks for tampering and untrusted sources in the skill supply chain.
